line.a_teatr.text: Tonight we're putting on a shadow theatre!

line.a_lalki.text: But we don't have any puppets.

line.a_z_ksztaltow.text: We'll make them from shapes. Every piece has its place. A house first.

line.a_pomoge.text: I'll help! This triangle goes on the roof.

line.a_nie_pasuje.text: It doesn't fit! This triangle is wrong. I'm throwing it away.

line.a_nie_wyrzucaj.text: Bear, don't throw it away! The triangle is fine, it's just turned the wrong way.

line.a_obroc.text: Tap a piece and it turns. Turn it until it fits, then drag it into place.

line.a_pasuje.text: It fits! It only needed turning.

line.a_do_teatru.text: The first puppet is ready. Let's go to the theatre!

line.b_ekran.text: What a big screen! There's a lamp shining behind it.

line.b_ryba.text: Make a fish on the screen. Tap to turn and drag the pieces into place.

line.b_plynie.text: Look, the fish's shadow is swimming!

line.b_lodka.text: Now a boat! Make it from the pieces.

line.b_plynie_lodka.text: The boat is rocking on the waves!

line.b_kot.text: From the same shapes we'll make something completely new: a cat!

line.b_czyj.text: Whose shadow is this? Point to it.

line.b_czyj_nie.text: Look at the shadow's shape: the ears, the tail, the paws.

line.b_czyj_nie.wiewiorka.text: Look at the shadow's shape: the ears, the tail, the paws.

line.b_zajac.text: It's the bunny's shadow! It has long ears.

line.b_przedstawienie.text: The show is ready! A round of applause for the actors!

line.b_koniec.text: The best theatre in the world!

line.p_start.text: Let's make pictures from pieces! I have five games.

line.p_luka.text: A piece is missing from the house. Which one fits the gap? Point to it.

line.p_za_duzy.text: That triangle has the right shape, but it's too big. Look for a smaller one.

line.p_inny.text: That piece has a different shape from the gap.

line.p_lodka.text: Make a boat. The pieces need turning.

line.p_czyj.text: And whose shadow is this? Point to it.

line.p_jez.text: It's the hedgehog's shadow! It has spikes.

line.h_kuchnia.text: We can make pictures in the kitchen too! First a square from two triangles.

line.h_dobrze.text: Lovely! The same pieces, different pictures.

line.h_rodzice.text: Cut a square out of paper with your parents, cut it into triangles and make pictures together. And in the evening put on a shadow theatre with a torch!

line.naklejka_daj.text: Thank you for a wonderful theatre! Here is a sticker for your album. Touch it to take it.

line.naklejka_juz.text: You already have the sticker from this adventure. See you!

line.naklejka_opis.text: This is a colourful block. We got it when we made puppets from pieces for Owl's shadow theatre.
